label: DPA-4-Air (OMol)
elements: Li, Be, B, C, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S
notes: Small DPA-4 on OMol25 (local preview checkpoint dpa4_omol_air_tmp.pt).  Same environment as DPA-4-Pro; the checkpoint is not a public release, so its training corpus is recorded as incomplete.

datasets.label: OMol25
datasets.notes: Open Molecules 2025 (Meta FAIR), wB97M-V/def2-TZVPD, 83 elements, systems up to 350 atoms.  Counts are the paper's own rounding -- it states 'more than 100 million' calculations over '~83M unique molecular systems' (arXiv:2505.08762), so treat n_structures as a lower bound.
